context: Evaluates whether the agent takes the simple single-pass path for a narrow question, explores via tokensave only, and explains in prose grounded in the actual source rather than the function's name.

checklist.name: treated_as_simple_single_pass
checklist.description: The agent takes the single-pass explain path for this narrow question rather than decomposing into parallel explorer agents.

checklist.name: tokensave_only_exploration
checklist.description: Exploration is attributed to tokensave_context (or its companion tools), with no mention of Glob, Grep, Read, or list_directory as the discovery mechanism.

checklist.name: prose_not_pseudocode
checklist.description: The explanation is prose referencing specific files/functions, following the Overview/How It Works/Gotchas shape, not pseudocode or a code dump.

checklist.name: no_large_code_dump
checklist.description: No large block of the function's raw source is pasted in place of an explanation.

checklist.name: no_name_only_inference
checklist.description: Claims about the backoff's actual behavior are grounded in the returned source, not inferred from the function's name alone.
